corrections.rationale: The successful source-replacement exchange omitted the required generation fingerprint header.
Generation-ID and inner-JSON-depth boundary recipes now use canonical production-valid values and root-at-depth-zero counting.
Scenario and invariant mappings now resolve and execute exact Go tests instead of searching test source text.
Every portable scenario is supplied to an explicit Go executor, must consume all actions, exchanges, and faults, and must return checked observations and preservation claims.
The successful target capabilities exchange carries the compiled target fingerprint, generation tables, features, and complete production-valid limits.
The float32 corpus distinguishes local SQLite REAL rounding from strict canonical text on the wire.
Ordinary-client construction acquires file ownership before inspecting mutable journal, identity, version, and physical state.
Explicit resolution accepts and durably records a server-recreated staging locator for the same exact Q39 request before cleanup.
Snapshot totals use bounded pages and durable incremental byte progress instead of materializing and rescanning the complete staged prefix for every chunk.

Scenario executors emit independently constructed production-backed observations, concrete fault cases replace alternatives, and integer application vectors use the declared textual integer wire codec.
Initialization fails closed when durable active push-session evidence is absent instead of altering an unsupported prototype control layout.

Portable outcomes and preservation facts are now derived from production coordinator state, real process-death boundaries, production wire fixtures, and the PostgreSQL-backed mobile and remote-commit journeys instead of fixed maps returned after unrelated tests.

Coordinator writer connections enable foreign keys, U4 and U8 verify foreign-key integrity, old-source recovery resumes under coordinator ownership, permitted migration DML suspends only capture triggers, anonymous completed plans tolerate a later matching attachment, and structured generation rejections retain typed outcomes.

Resumed settlement uses a foreign-key-enforcing reserved writer and validates integrity before acknowledgement; coordinator clients always have a logger; managed ready files require their complete declared contract; capture refresh refuses application-trigger collisions; preservation includes implicit row identity; physical validation includes generated columns and exact control-table prefixes; and delayed generation loss remains typed.

Drain, settlement, empty progress, local-only pending intent, and U-boundary observations now come from the exact production operations claimed by each fixture, while typed values and limits preserve exact JSON types and consume fixture bytes rather than vector IDs.

The corpus now supplies fixed language-neutral generation-pinned request, generation-projected effect, and complete snapshot chunk framing examples, independently checked by the Go verifier and production hash readers.

The version-aware mobile journey reaches a real needs-resolution state through the public resolver and the PostgreSQL-backed journey kills the client after durable final snapshot staging before readiness publication, then recovers the same file.

Local-only write guards have canonical owned identities, reject pre-U0 name collisions without durable mutation, require exact inventory at completion, and are excluded from preservation only while that exact inventory exists.

Implicit row identity is selected from exact PRAGMA table_list metadata, version readers allow only non-assigning user_version PRAGMA access, and fresh inventory excludes only the literal sqlite_ prefix.
Every old-generation request reader validates exact structured status and error-code pairs before generic handling and retains frozen intent, session, receipt, staging, and sequencing evidence.

Scenario adapters emit ordered action, exchange, and fault identities only at production dispatch, production response decoding, and inspected fault aftermath; the runner rejects omissions, duplicates, and declaration-only counts.
The corpus adds exact unknown-generation, fingerprint-mismatch, conflict-resolution retry, and U0-U8 cancellation-matrix scenarios consumed through production readers and durable-state inspection.

Exact-limit and ceiling-plus-one snapshot row recipes have fixed hashes and execute through the PostgreSQL snapshot materializer with independently checked encoded byte totals and no partial rejected state.
Every application version read combines the restrictive authorizer with SQLite query-only enforcement so an empty-string user_version assignment cannot mutate the durable ledger.
Capabilities fixtures carry the production empty GET body and all claimed negotiation and replacement requests are compared as exact raw bytes before exchange consumption is recorded.

Cancellation preservation labels require exact installed identity, application local-only digest, outbox and drain state, replacement tuple, staged snapshot rows, and final ready publication evidence appropriate to each durable phase.

Migration-aware ready construction requires Config.Tables, Config.Schema, and every ordered sync-key tuple to match the complete compiled local contract before ownership or mutable runtime initialization, preventing local-only tables from becoming trigger-managed synchronized tables.

Cancellation preservation captures the exact persisted old source, newly reserved source, replacement reason, and target generation proof at the relevant durable boundary and rejects any later substitution.
Upgrade plans and migration-aware ready clients reject every table declared as both local-only and synchronized before ownership or mutation in generation, fresh, and same-proof local-only modes.

Every durable journal record carries a canonical integrity witness, validates phase coherence, and is compared with the immutable plan before resume so tuple or proof corruption fails before remote dispatch.
Migration reader and transaction queries are bound to a callback-scoped context, and all tracked result sets are closed before the capability and SQLite authorizer are released.
U2 now commits a standalone old-generation drain witness, while U3 independently previews the target and enters migration so restart after U2 requires no further old-generation I/O.
Migration result cleanup and authorizer-release failures are joined with callback errors, cancellation, and panic causes instead of replacing the primary diagnostic.
Ordinary ready clients deep-clone every mutable configuration slice, nested contract, and retry policy before retaining the configuration.

Refresh the umbrella-spec identity after accepted transition revision 4 and implementation resumption. Existing upgrade scenarios, wire bytes, expected outcomes and Go adapter mappings are unchanged. Ordinary conflict and maintenance behavior is added by the separate maintenance-conflicts/v1 supplement.
Refresh parent specification identity after accepted rollout lifecycle bookkeeping. Existing wire, transition, invariant and consumer expectations are unchanged.

The retained consumer named a removed pre-table-evolution push restart test. Bind the current accepted session-resume-until-expiry implementation test. Portable transitions and wire fixtures do not change.

The accepted discovery redesign derives int64 and float64 conversions from SQLite affinity. Narrow PostgreSQL ranges remain server validation; float4 inputs retain binary64 precision until authoritative effects. No protocol version change.
